articles.summary: Altria Group, Inc. (Altria) (NYSE: MO) will host a live audio webcast on Thursday, October 29, 2026, at 9:00 a.m. Eastern Time to discuss its 2026 third-quarter and nine-months business results. Altria will issue a press release containing its business results at approximately 7:00 a.m. Eastern Time the same day. The webcast can be accessed at altria.com . During the webcast, Sal Mancuso, Altria’s Chief Executive Officer, and Heather Newman, Altria’s Chief Financial Officer, will discuss the Company’s 2026 third-quarter and nine-months business results and answer questions from the investment community and news media. The webcast will be in a listen-only mode. Pre-event registration is necessary; directions are posted at www.altria.com/webcasts . An archived copy of the webcast will be available on altria.com . Investor Relations, Altria Client Services (804) 484-8222 Media Relations, Altria Client Services www.altria.com/contact-us/media Source: Altria Group, Inc.
articles.title: Altria to Host Webcast of 2026 Third-Quarter and Nine-Months Results

articles.summary: Paige Spiranac and Team Grass League claimed golf’s orangest jacket following a dramatic comeback victory, with Flo Rida bringing the two-day event to an electrifying close with a hit-filled performance Helix Innovations LLC, an operating company of Altria Group, Inc. (Altria) (NYSE: MO), today announced the winners of on!® nicotine pouches’ inaugural on!vitational, held October 16 and 17 at TGL’s SoFi Center in Palm Beach Gardens, Florida. The two-day golf and entertainment experience brought together eight teams of current and former professional athletes, golf personalities, entertainers and adult nicotine consumers age 25+ for a competition that combined golf, technology and entertainment. Well-known golf influencer Paige Spiranac and Team Grass League, including former professional golfer Drew Kittleson and Grass League co-founder Jimmy Hoselton, captured the inaugural on!vitational Championship. articles.summary: Altria Group, Inc. (NYSE: MO) today reports our 2026 third-quarter and nine-months business results and raises our guidance for 2026 full-year adjusted diluted earnings per share (EPS). “Altria delivered strong financial performance in the third quarter, growing adjusted diluted earnings per share by 4.8%, while continuing to invest in our Vision and building on our foundation for the future,” said Sal Mancuso, Altria’s Chief Executive Officer. “In smokeable products, PM USA grew operating companies income through its data-driven, total portfolio approach, with Cowboy Cut strengthening Marlboro ’s premium position and Basic continuing to gain share in discount.
